title: YAML flow collections that mention secrets by name: must be flagged
summary: Block-style YAML `secret:` holding a synthetic literal, and a quoted value that merely starts with a brace. Covers 2 inputs.
rationale: Kubernetes-style manifests use `secret` as a structural key. Treating a name or a reference in a flow collection as a credential is a false alarm.

expectation.rationale: Issue-specific literal/password range; expectations are the project’s masking policy.
